name: ECal
welcome: Welcome to **ECal**, a calendar for the Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon. It waits in the Desk menu as an accessory (or runs as a program), keeps your iCloud and other CalDAV calendars in step, reminds you of what's coming and invites people from EContact.

window.title: The window
items: Calendars: yours, each in its colour. See [[Adding calendars]].
Day, Week, Month or Year, and Refresh.
The month: a click goes to that day.

diagram.title: How ECal reaches your calendars
diagram.round: [[Direct connection|Settings]]: a TT or Falcon does TLS itself (TLS.OVL)
after: iCloud and most servers want an encrypted connection. A Raspberry Pi on your network can do it for any Atari, or a Falcon or TT can do it itself (a Direct connection, with TLS.OVL). A server without TLS needs neither. See [[Installing]].
